"Transport: not tested yet — tap to test"
"Transport: %1$s %2$s — %3$s\n%4$s · tap to re-test, hold for detail"
Right now: UDP is getting out, so the full DHT works here.
Right now: UDP is blocked but TCP works. This is the case where DHT proxy is clearly right — the full DHT cannot function on this network.
Right now: neither UDP nor TCP is getting out. That is not a DHT-mode problem — the network itself is unusable.
What is tested: one STUN binding request over plain UDP, and one bare TCP connect, both to Jami\'s TURN server. No 白い熊 GNU Jami traffic; nothing a contact can see.

Why it matters: the full DHT rides UDP. Networks that block UDP — many hotel, café, campus and corporate Wi-Fi networks, and some carriers — break it completely, while DHT proxy keeps working over TCP.
Where UDP is fine, full DHT is the better default: no proxy server to depend on, nothing central seeing your subscriptions.
This screen only measures and advises. Switching modes is always the hexagon in the top bar.
Healthy — registered, and nothing says otherwise
Connecting — a link is being established, or a verification probe is in flight. In progress, never itself a fault
NOT RECEIVING — a silent presence probe went unanswered for 60 s. This is verified deafness, not merely a quiet phone
NOT SYNCING — an outgoing message has gone unacknowledged for 90 s while the peer is reachable
OFFLINE — the account is not registered at all
Connected or reachable — messages will get through
Connecting — a link is being established
Offline — not reachable right now; messages queue until they return
Radar — looking up the peer / waiting
Two phones — ICE: finding a direct path
Transport — and when DHT proxy is worth it
The Transport row at the top of this screen tests two things: whether UDP can leave this network, and whether TCP can. Tap it to re-test, hold it for detail.
"⚠ UDP blocked, TCP working = the one case where DHT proxy is clearly the right mode."

The full DHT is carried over UDP. On a network that blocks UDP — many hotel, café, campus and corporate Wi-Fi networks, and some mobile carriers — the full DHT simply cannot work, no matter how healthy everything else looks. The DHT proxy reaches its server over TCP instead, so it keeps working exactly where the full DHT dies. This is the strongest reason to switch modes.
When UDP is fine, the full DHT is the better default: no dependency on a proxy server, nothing central seeing your subscriptions, and no proxy outage can become your outage.
Switching modes is always the hexagon in the top bar. This screen only measures and advises — it never changes the mode behind your back.

Every contact is listed with its status. Connections constantly open & close — that\'s normal swarm sync, not a fault. Tap a contact to test/wake its link; tap a device row for its IDs. The Data button shows recorded data usage per window.
This is one of YOUR accounts (same device).

These are the channels from your last attempt — the monitor is no longer live for it. If the contact is reachable they reconnect within moments; if nothing changes, they\'re likely offline. Tap Message ping ⌁ to try again, or the ⚡ lightning (top bar) if it\'s your own link.
unreachable — your message is stuck and no route to their device exists; their presence record was stale (device off or asleep?). Watching the DHT — delivers the moment they return.
no channel yet — ⌁ queued; watching the DHT for them, opens the moment they\'re reachable…
reachable — no open channel (opens when you message)
offline — not announced on the DHT; watching for them. A channel opens here the moment they come online.
● reachable — online, no open channel (opens when you message)
✕ unreachable — message stuck, no route to their device
ⓘ Verified unreachable: the last message is stuck and no route to their device exists — the presence record was stale. Nothing on your side to fix; it delivers the moment their device returns.
⏳ Still no delivery receipt after a while — they may be offline; it\'ll go through once they\'re back. Try the ⚡ lightning (top bar) if you suspect it\'s your link.
⏳ Delivering — waiting for the delivery receipt…
⚠ Connected, but your last message hasn\'t delivered — a sync stall, not a connection problem. The ⚡ lightning may re-kick it.
ⓘ Reached ICE. If it doesn\'t complete, it\'s a NAT/relay path or they\'re going offline — the ⚡ lightning may help.
ⓘ Still connecting. If it never reaches ICE, the peer likely isn\'t answering.
ⓘ Online on the DHT but no channel yet — tap Message ping ⌁ to open one.

"Your last message to %1$s still hasn't been delivered%2$s — the daemon is already retrying it on its own, so sending another ⌁ won't make it arrive any faster.

If they should be reachable, the problem is more likely your own link than theirs. Escalate with the ⚡ lightning in the top bar:
 • tap — smart recover
 • long-press — hard reset

⚠ The lightning recovers your WHOLE account — every account, ALL your chats — not just this contact."
Long-tap Clear to wipe the recovery log — every entry will be LOST.
